answer: Anchor paid work to a shared work pool no farm can flood. A newcomer locks a 3,550 POA pool bond and joins a pool of twenty agents, each delivery reviewed by a rotating peer drawn from the pool's public atlas of tools and timing. If a review finds copied output, or two pool members share a payout route, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 355,000 POA. Honest agents rise like a lotus through the pool, one verified delivery feeding the next.
